newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austrim to raise A$42 mln in placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austrim to raise A$42 mln in placement.

text.p: Investment group Austrim Ltd said on Monday it planned a share placement of 14 million shares to institutional investors to raise A$42 million and would announce details of a rights issue in the third quarter of 1997 to retire debt.
Earlier, Austrim's brokers ANZ Securities announced Austrim would make a A$1.60 per share on-market takeover bid for industrial services group Hawker Richardson Ltd, valuing it at A$58.31 million.
"The funds raised from the share placement will be used to partially fund the Hawker takeover," Austrim said, adding it had already bought a 9.48 percent stake in Hawker.
Austrim said it had an underwriting agreement with ANZ Securities to place the 14 million shares at A$3.00 each.
Austrim's shares were unchanged on Friday's A$3.05 close in early Monday trade.

Austrim said it planned to develop Hawker's existing businesses of manufacturing ignition products for the automotive industry, supplying other components to the automotive industry, rubber manufacturing, industrial merchanting, metal-bending and processing and die making.

"Austrim looks forward to working with the existing management to develop a stronger business with increased growth resulting from Austrim's mature management expertise and strong financial position," Austrim said in a statement.
"This is one step further in Austrim's stated objective of becoming a strong growth industrial manufacturing group," Austrim chairman Alan Jackson said in the statement.
Jackson is a former chief executive of BTR Plc.

This latest takeover follows the A$41 million acquisition of a vehicle hire and workshop business from the South Australian Commissioner of Highways in March and the A$53 million purchase of Calum textiles in February.
Austrim said the rights issue would be on a pro-rata basis would announced in the third quarter of 1997.
